actualInspection.fachlichePruefung: A diverse civic discussion considers housing, education and work as shared opportunities and challenges. People retain equal dignity and contribute as participants; appearance does not label anyone as a migrant, dependent burden or fixed cultural representative. The question avoids guaranteeing integration outcomes.
actualInspection.phone: At 360 px the shared discussion, housing/book/gear icons and large judgment question are recognizable. Secondary slogans are decorative.
actualInspection.desktop: At 680 px the concrete housing, learning and work topics and reciprocal participation are clear.
actualInspection.actorPerspective: The moderator holds a tablet facing herself while its plain back faces the audience; people face the discussion and public board. No actor-inverted readable page occurs.
actualInspection.style: Friendly clear comic raster, coherent broad colors and approachable people, without photorealism or sterile technical restyling.

interpretationLimits: The picture introduces shared social and political questions; it does not identify migrants by appearance, quantify migration effects or decide a specific migration policy.
